title: Multimodal psychodynamic group therapy in routine day-clinic and inpatient care: Naturalistic study on effectiveness and adverse events
summary: This study aims to examine the effectiveness and side effects of the treatment program at the study clinic. For this purpose, patients, their therapists, and the patients' relatives will be surveyed at several time points.
conditions: All ICD-10 or ICD-11 F-diagnoses treated in the study center.
